text: yeah i keep restarting it. its not there. [Image #26]
resolution: Root-caused the vanishing buildings: the iso pane's floor-level cut-away (visiblePieces drops any piece whose storey p.y-groundTopAt >= (level+1)*METERS_PER_LEVEL) was stripping the entire multi-storey city. A render census proved it — at level 0, 1036 of 1472 pieces cut (673 walls, 104 roofs, 221 floors; cutStorey 3..33m), only ground-floor pieces survived. The cut-away is a look-inside-one-floor tool and reveals only one level at a time, so raising the level never showed whole buildings. Fix (79da84357): a showAllFloors twig defaulting ON gates the cut-away, so the pane shows the full building stack by default; the cut-away is opt-in via a new ⌷ toggle. Restart ruled out the host geometry cache; dedup/stairs were unrelated. POSSIBLE follow-up: the transient 'rounded/cylinder' rendering (req_0720) is a separate geometry issue if it recurs.
